description: Phase 0 baseline metrics — recorded at the start of the contract harness work (WO-005).

priorTestCount.detail: One test file (contracts.smoke.test.ts) with 3 assertions in booking-service. Zero contract tests in contracts package before WO-001.

duplicatedDeclarationsRemoved.detail: WO-001 established @travel/contracts as the single source of truth before any service scaffolding. WO-004 removed all locally declared platform payload types from the Next.js frontend (BookabilityState, FormErrorState, ApiResult retained as presentational-only types). No inter-service duplicates to count yet.

validatedRouteBoundaries.detail: booking-service/test/error-serialiser.integration.test.ts (from WO-002) validates the CreateBookingRequest → serialiseError route boundary end-to-end. The remaining eight service boundaries are scaffolded by WO-005 consumer fixture tests.

coverageGateTarget: 80% branch coverage on contracts package and shared/middleware
phaseExitCriteria: Consumer fixture tests present for all 9 services + web app
